changes: TextFile reads regular files in binary, checks read completion, preserves output on failure and rejects embedded NUL paths.
YamlFile translates I/O failure to YAML::BadFile; all first-party YAML::LoadFile call sites use the same boundary while retaining caller state-commit policies.
Stage snapshots, progress loading and UGC byte comparisons use the checked reader. UGC comparison no longer relies on an unchecked second iterator after file_size.
AtomicFile rejects embedded NUL destinations instead of overwriting an OS-truncated path.
UGC generated platforms reserve previous IDs before rebuilding so new regions cannot steal later-restored identities.
Two bundled UGC documents retain geometry, cells and valid connections; only unreferenced duplicate definitions receive fresh IDs and the unresolved platform_8 target is removed.
Known-invalid asset allowance removed; every bundled YAML must validate. CRLF/LF regression now asserts the same normalized digest and rejects malformed content in both cases.
